name: National Assembly of Zimbabwe
notes: 10th Parliament (elected August 2023): 210 constituency seats, 60 women list seats and 10 youth seats. The split is from CITE's report of the 18 June 2026 vote on Constitution Amendment Bill No. 3 (86 CCC, 194 ZANU-PF); the Parliament's own member list could not be read (its site answers scripts with a bot check). Seats left empty by recalls and by-elections have moved between parties since 2023, so check the figure against Hansard. No supporter is shown as sitting: Nyashanu's seat in this Parliament was not checked. Unlit seats mean nothing found yet, never opposition.
